source_edition.restoration: Open the LSE source record and select viewer item 519929 (printed pages X-XI) or 519930 (printed pages XII-XIII). The viewer issues time-limited download tokens; regenerate them from the public record page when restoring and verify the downloaded single-page PDF hashes above. The record page HTML hash is a separate catalogue snapshot, not the whole report PDF.

methods.retrieval: Fetched the public LSE record page and individual page PDFs for viewer items 519929 and 519930; recorded exact bytes and SHA-256. No whole-report copy was retained.
methods.inspection: Rendered page 11 and page 12 scans for visual reading. The image text is legible at high resolution; the viewer exposes no machine transcript for these images (isAvTranscribed=false). Numeric values were read visually from the printed table and checked against the table's stated increase (2,564,965 minus 2,563,024 equals 1,941). No OCR values used.
methods.territorial_scope: Only the named source-era Cape of Good Hope province row was transcribed. The report's opening table is province-level, not municipality or settlement-level. It separately points to a district increase/decrease schedule; that schedule is outside this sample. The report also notes geographic boundary changes between earlier comparisons, which are not converted into modern geographies.
methods.uncertainty: No source geometry, district membership, municipality/settlement table, census undercount interval, or individual-response record was evaluated. The opening table's preliminary/final difference is a source-published revision, not an uncertainty interval.

illustrative_rows.note: One Cape Province all-races reconciliation row is transcribed from the scan. The two race subcategory totals are not copied here.
